hash_distinction_note: input_file_sha256 hashes serialized parquet bytes (varies across writer metadata/compression); logical_records_sha256 hashes deterministically sorted canonical rows (timestamp_utc, hashed_ip, model, country) with fillna('').

field_mapping.service_axis_m5: 5 OpenAI model families (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4-turbo, other-openai)
field_mapping.category_axis_A20: 20 interaction-category proxies = 5 model_families x 4 UTC_6h_quadrants (NOT semantic NLP task topics)
field_mapping.user_identifier: hashed_ip (IP-derived pseudonym; NOT authenticated account ID)
field_mapping.timestamp_semantics: Top-level WildChat timestamp is the last turn of the conversation (NOT HTTP request timestamp)
field_mapping.unit_of_record: 1 conversation record (NOT 1 raw HTTP API request)
